name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (battle domain, descriptor accurately = process battle drop entries). No address residue. Descriptor matches body: iterates 3-byte drop entries and applies item/gold/event/dialog effects to a recipient char after a battle kill.
purpose: After a battle kill, process the accumulated 3-byte drop entries (item / gold / chapter-event / scripted-dialog) and apply each to the recipient character (typically the killer), showing reward dialogs for the player team.
logic_summary: Returns immediately if entry_count==0. Loops over entry_count 3-byte entries (byte type + ushort value). Per entry: clear kbd buffer, read type/value. type 0 ITEM (gate recipient.team==2 else early return): set last_action_sprite_id=value+0xB5, load portrait, dialog 0x1B0, fd2_add_item_to_inventory; if bag full (-1) run discard/swap flow (dialog 0x1B1 'which to drop?', typewriter loop; if confirmed slot 0: remove old slot item + re-add new + continue; else show 'took'/'dropped' dialog 0x1B2). type 1 GOLD (gate team==2 else early return): load portrait, dialog 0x1B3, party_total_gold += value. type 2 EVENT (no gate): delay 200, call chapter event handler table[value](recipient_idx). type 3 DIALOG (no gate): display scripted FDTXT page `value` from current chapter text. Other type: skip. The team!=2 early return on type 0/1 abandons the remaining entries.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_process_battle_drop_entries(uint32 recipient_idx, uint32 entry_count, uint32 entry_array_ptr)

params.name: recipient_idx
params.semantics: Index into runtime_char_array of the drop recipient (typically the killer). Used to gate on .team==2, fetch .portrait_id for dialog, and as the char arg to add/remove inventory, modal dispatch, and the type-2 event handler.
params.reason: Accurately names the recipient slot index; no address residue; matches body usage.

params.name: entry_count
params.semantics: Number of 3-byte drop entries in entry_array_ptr (returned by fd2_collect_dead_char_drops / fd2_collect_pending_death_drops).
params.reason: Accurate loop bound name; no residue.

params.name: entry_array_ptr
params.semantics: Base pointer to the packed array of 3-byte drop entries; entry i at entry_array_ptr + i*3 (byte type @ +0, ushort value @ +1).
params.reason: Name accurately describes the entry-array base pointer (it is a pointer passed as uint32; the type is pre-existing and out of scope for renaming). No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects: mutates recipient inventory, party gold, dialog staging globals, fires chapter event handlers, and drives reward dialog UI.

reads_globals: data_fd2_all_game_text_ptr - FDTXT base for reward dialogs 0x1B0..0x1B3
data_fd2_current_chapter_text - FDTXT base for type-3 scripted dialog
data_fd2_dialog_last_action_value_param (0x53AE1) - read back when adding to party gold
